depiction.primary_object: open-top picture frame containing two mountain peaks
modifiers: curved counterclockwise arrow above the frame
depiction.composition: single composite glyph, front view, arrow arching over bottom half of image frame

readings.meaning: reset image edits or revert to original picture

ambiguity: Could be read either as rotating a photo counterclockwise or as restoring/resetting an image to its prior state.

modifier_semantics.modifier: curved counterclockwise arrow above the frame

reasoning: The icon combines the standard mountain-in-frame symbol for an image with a counterclockwise arrow on top, clearly signifying rotating, resetting, or restoring a photo. It fits specific digital photography, scanning, and file-recovery tasks well, though general photo tasks are better served by a plain image or camera icon.
